title: Review of c45's Marangoni turnover-long finding on fresh seed 83: turnover with returned matter keeps the rods dividing (48 dividing tracks vs 16 without dilution), the swim-3-lengths minority stays rare (2 of 48) and is redrawn each cycle (slope -0.37 [-0.73, +0.10]); divisions stop after t~1600, as on the author's seed 81
summary: Re-ran the finding's world.py on seed 83 (128^2, 400 frames, T=2000) with p_dil 0.10 and REDIST 1, and without dilution (p_dil 0), then c00's extract.py, the finding's turnover_stats.py (40-frame windows, 48-frame cohorts) and c00's analyze.py. Dilution: 81 bodies removed in 40 events, 50 persistent splits (labkit 58, generation 11), 2-11 per 40 frames up to frame 320 and none after (last persistent split at frame 319, with 23-27 bodies present to frame 400), 48 dividing tracks, median D 1.30 rod lengths, D >= 3 in 2 of 48. No dilution: 34 persistent splits, 1-3 per window after frame 160, 16 dividing tracks, merge/split 0.57. Parent-offspring D on D: n=25, slope -0.37 [-0.73, +0.10] against a time-matched null of +0.15 (P(null >= obs) 0.997).

observations.finding: runs/dil_s83/stats.txt: 2-11 persistent splits per 40 frames to frame 320 and 48 dividing tracks, against 16 without dilution (runs/nodil_s83/stats.txt); D >= 3 in 2 of 48; runs/heredity_s83.txt D-on-D slope -0.37 [-0.73, +0.10], upper bound below +0.3, so the trait is not inherited

verdicts.limitation: On seed 83, as on the author's seed 81, no persistent split occurs after frame 320 (t=1600) although 23-27 bodies remain and the lineage window K=20 would count splits to frame 380; so 'steady to T~1800' holds to about T=1600, and a longer run should check whether division resumes. One fresh seed; mar 0 floor not rerun.
